title: Gauri Mahulikar on Sanskrit
context: Prachyam · Indiclass · Gauri Mahulikar on Sanskrit
desc: Scripts, language maps and illustrated traditions in motion.
lead: I created motion sequences for Prachyam’s Gauri Mahulikar on Sanskrit, combining script details, explanatory typography, maps and illustrations.
body: I led creative direction and visual design for the selected sequences from Gauri Mahulikar on Sanskrit. The work moves between close studies of script, typographic explanations and illustrated scenes.
detail: The selection covers Brahmi script, Shruti and Smruti, language families, and Shiv and Shakti. I developed the composition, typography and motion treatment across these pieces.
contribution: Led creative direction and hands-on visual design for the selected sequences.
Developed composition, typography and motion treatments for script details, explanations, maps and illustrations.
summary: I created motion sequences for Prachyam’s Gauri Mahulikar on Sanskrit, combining script details, explanatory typography, maps and illustrations.
